title: Try the deposit, start to finish
subtitle: A two-minute test event with test money. No sign-in. Pay a deposit, get checked in, and get it back.
notice: This wallet was made in this browser and only holds test tokens on Solana devnet. Nothing here is real money.
guard_note: The faucet is protected by rate limits and a daily cap only.
off_body: It runs on the BeThere staging site only.
unsupported: This browser cannot make a test wallet (it needs Ed25519 in Web Crypto). Try a current Chrome, Safari or Firefox.
step_event_hint: BeThere's sandbox organizer opens an event with a 1 USDC deposit. It ends two minutes from now.
step_faucet_hint: The faucet sends 1 test USDC, plus a little test SOL for fees.
step_deposit_hint: Your 1 USDC goes into the event's escrow: held by the on-chain program, not by a person.
step_checkin_hint: At a real event, staff scan your ticket. Here the sandbox organizer checks you in.
step_wait: Wait for the event to end
step_wait_hint: Deposits come back once the event is over.
step_refund_hint: The escrow sends your 1 USDC back to your wallet.
step_return_hint: Optional: give the test USDC back so the next visitor can use it.
done_body: That is the whole BeThere promise: show up and your deposit comes back.
start_over: Start over with a new wallet
signer_why: Practising with your own wallet on devnet takes the same steps as a USDC deposit at a BeThere event.
signer_none: No Solana wallet found in this browser. The test wallet works without one; to practise with your own, install Phantom or Solflare and set it to Devnet.
faucet_more: More test tokens for your own wallet:
notice_own: You are using your own wallet on Solana devnet: test tokens only, no real money moves.
